_about: W8 (ClawClips.cs): claw bodies play their attack_clips.json gcl_* rows. glb = clips-only extract in StreamingAssets (7 gcl clips). map: gcl state -> DONOR clip/state of the body's own controller (the gcl clip replaces the donor clip through an AnimatorOverrideController; the donor state is what plays). Donors are the controller slots the claw moves would otherwise play as sword clips (light_attack_R is shared by the atk_* / maul_* states; heavy_windup and heavy_windup_hold are not played while an attack_clips row is active). characters = roster ids. enabled false / no file = the old sword fallback.
